title: Define ModelClient.complete error-path semantics (throw vs typed Result)
description: cck.5 code review (Important): AgentSdkModelClient.complete returns empty string '' on SDKResultError or a stream with no result message, and the ModelClient contract has no error-path semantics. For E1 Orchestrator / E3 DM loop a silent empty return manifests as blank narration. Decide and implement throw-on-error vs a typed Result return for ModelClient.complete. E0 deliberately defers this; must be resolved before E1 Orchestrator integration.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #10 (branch work/cck-followups); typecheck clean, 166 tests pass.
